world_began.text: In the first years {m_word} courts shared the valley.

genesis_rival_kingdoms.text: In the first years the crowns of men divided the vales between them, and no crown would bow to another.

genesis_dwarf_empire.text: In the first years a dwarf empire still held the valley from its halls, though its lords had grown old and its vassals restless.

genesis_elven_realm.text: In the first years the elves ruled the woods and the land around them, and men lived under their trees on sufferance.

genesis_orc_horde.text: In the first years an orc horde already held the scar, and every spring the valley counted its dead.

genesis_free_cities.text: In the first years there were no kings in the valley: free cities of every people traded, quarrelled and kept their own walls.

genesis_fallen_kingdom.text: In the first years the valley was a field of ruins: the kingdom of {O} had fallen, and its heirs fought over the stones.

genesis_the_exodus.text: In the first years men came over the rim with nothing, and the elder peoples of the valley gave them leave to stay.

genesis_the_undying_queen.text: In the first years one throne held most of the valley, and its ruler had held it longer than anyone could remember.

genesis_the_empty_valley.text: In the first years the valley was nearly empty: a sickness had passed through, and only a few villages kept their fires.

war_started_genesis.text: {S} and {O} were at war, as they had been for as long as anyone remembered.

egg_hatched.text: In {o} an egg cracked, and something looked out at the valley.

undying_rose.text: {O} of {S} did not die when the years came for them, and then did not die at all.

undying_fell.text: The undying reign over {S} ended after {m0} years{why}.
undying_fell.brief: the end of the undying reign over {s} in {year}

race_extinct.text: The last of the {s_race} were gone from the valley, and no song says where they went.

people_arrived.text: From beyond the rim came the {t0_race} of {S}, a people no song in the valley had named, and they took {o}.

vale_broke.text: The earth opened under {s}, and the vale became a scar of ash and stone.

fen_drowned.text: The rains did not stop over {s} until the fen was a lake, and the lake is there still.

the_queen_who_does_not_die.text: {O} of {S} had ruled for centuries and did not look it, and the court stopped counting her years.

the_king_who_stopped_dying.text: {O} of {S} did not die when he should have, and then did not die at all.

age_of_magic.text: In {year} the old powers woke: lamps lit themselves in the scholars' towers, and an age of magic began.

colleges_of_magic.text: The towers of {S} glowed at night, and the neighbours stopped sleeping.

wild_surge_fey.text: The sky over {s} turned the wrong colour for a season, and afterwards the fields grew too well.

wild_surge_blight.text: The sky over {s} turned the wrong colour for a season, and afterwards nothing grew right.

necromancers_tower.text: A scholar of {O} went into the waste, and the dead began to walk out of it: {S}.

restless_dead.text: The dead of {o} would not lie still: {S} rose from the ruins and claimed them.
restless_dead.brief: the rising of the dead at {o} in {year}

the_dead_walk.text: The dead walked out of {o}, and the living called the host {S}.

the_plague_dead.text: The plague dead of {O} rose from their pits and took the land they had died on: {S}.
the_plague_dead.brief: the rising of the plague dead in {year}

great_plague.text: The sickness came up the river, and in three years a third of the valley was in the ground.

comet.text: A comet hung over the valley for a season, and every court read it as a sign of war.

the_dance_of_claimants.text: The realm of {S} split between two claimants, and brother burned brother for a generation.
the_dance_of_claimants.brief: the war of the claimants of {s} in {year}

hero_unites.text: {O} rose in {S} when the realm was falling apart, and the realm rallied to a hero.

festival.text: {S} held a festival that people talked about for a generation.

temple_raised.text: {S} raised a great temple, and pilgrims came from every corner of the valley.

town_founded.text: {S} founded a new town, and within a generation it had walls and a market.
town_founded.brief: the founding of a town in {s} in {year}

royal_birth.text: {O} of {S} had a child, and the bells rang for a week.

long_winter.text: The snow did not leave the vales for seven years, and the granaries emptied one by one.

holy_war.text: The priests of {S} declared the altars of {O} abominable, and the swords followed the priests.
holy_war.brief: the holy war of {s} on {o} in {year}

the_last_of_their_kind.text: {O}, the last realm of the {s_race}, dwindled year by year until its halls stood empty, and there were no more {s_race} in the valley.

people_from_beyond_men.text: Men came over the rim from lands no one in the valley had seen, and took {o}: the people of {S}.

people_from_beyond_horde.text: A horde came down from beyond the rim, and {o} became the camp of {S}.
people_from_beyond_horde.brief: the coming of the horde {s} in {year}

people_from_beyond_fen.text: A people came out of the fens beyond the rim that no song had mentioned: the saurians of {S}, and they took {o}.
people_from_beyond_fen.brief: the coming of the saurians of {s} in {year}

act_burn.text: You burned {o} of {s}; {m%} of its wealth went up in smoke.

act_kill.text: You fell on the people of {s}.

act_take.text: You carried {m%} of {s}'s wealth to the hoard.

act_receive.brief: your answer to the visitors of {s} in {year}

act_defend.text: You stood over {s} and drove off its attackers.

act_take_hostage.text: You took a hostage from the court of {s}.
act_take_hostage.brief: the hostage you took from {s} in {year}

act_release.text: You let the hostage of {s} go home.

act_destroy_altar.brief: the altar you broke in {s} in {year}

war_ended.text: The war of {S} against {O} ended in {t0_word}.
war_ended.brief: the end of the war of {s} on {o} in {year}

coalition_formed.text: {S} raised a coalition against the hegemon {O}.

coalition_ended.text: The coalition of {S} against {O} ended in {t0_word}.
coalition_ended.brief: the end of the coalition against {o} in {year}

joined_war.text: {S} joined the war on the side of {O}.

vassal_sworn.text: {S} swore fealty to {O} to keep its last land.

collapse_one.text: {S} fell, and a new house, {successors}, took its last land.

successor_founded.text: {S} was founded on {o} out of the ruins of {T0}.

faction_destroyed.text: {S} was wiped out; its people scattered as refugees.

slayers_founded.text: {S} founded an order of dragon slayers.
slayers_founded.brief: the slayer order of {s} founded in {year}

slay_attempt_failed.text: The slayers of {S}{led_by} marched on your lair and failed.

dragon_slain.text: The slayers of {S}{led_by} killed you in your lair.

dragon_slain_defences.text: The defences of {S} brought you down over {o}.

dragon_wounded.text: The defences of {S} wounded you over {o} ({m0}).

slayers_coming.text: A premonition woke you: the slayers of {S}{led_by} were on their way to your lair.
slayers_coming.brief: the slayers of {s} at your door in {year}

talent_taken.text: Your {t0_word} grew into a new gift: {o_word}.

slayers_forming.text: {S} gathered a slayer band{led_by} against you.

slayers_ready.text: The slayers of {S}{led_by} were ready to come for you in your next sleep (odds {m%} at your wounds then).

anti_dragon_progress.text: {S}'s work against you stood {m%} of the way to {o_word}.

tribute_paid.text: {S} sent tribute worth {m0} gold to the lair.

hegemony.text: {S} now held {m_word} regions, a hegemony over the valley.

bad_century.text: A bad century of poor harvests began in {s}.

volcanic_winter.text: Ash darkened the sky over the whole valley: a volcanic winter.

golden_age.text: A great ruler brought {S} a golden age of {m0} years.

succession_crisis.text: The succession in {S} was disputed, and the realm shook.

warlord_died.text: The warlord of {S} died and the horde fractured.

remnant_formed.text: The last realm of the {s_race} was gone; a remnant lingered around {o}.

remnant_formed_off_map.text: Beyond the valley the {s_race} gathered near {o}.

orcs_spawned.text: Orcs gathered on the ruined {o_bare}: the horde {S}.
orcs_spawned.brief: the horde that rose on {o} in {year}

elves_departed.text: The elves of {S} left {o} for good.

fading_begins.text: The elves of {S} began to fade: the valley belonged to the humans now.

fading_ends.text: The fading of {S} ended as the humans' share of the valley's wealth fell to {m%}.

wasteland_formed.text: {S} turned to wasteland under repeated fire.

wasteland_healed.text: Green returned to the wasteland of {s}.

oath_expired.brief: the lapse of your oath with {o} in {year}

oath_breached_by_dragon.text: You broke your oath of {t0_word} to {O}, and the court will remember the betrayal.

oath_breached_by_them.text: {O} broke its oath of {t0_word} to you.

spell_expired.brief: the fading of your spell on {o} in {year}

undead_raised.brief: the undead host you raised in {year}

dragon_raised_lineage.text: {O}, raised in your lair, took the throne of {S}: a dragon-raised line began.

raised_in_lair.text: {S}, {p:years0} years in your lair, is yours now more than {O}'s.

hostage_taken.text: {S}, {role} of {O}, was carried off to your lair.

hostage_released.text: {S} went home to {O} after {m0} years in your lair.

dragon_atrophied.text: In your sleep you wasted a little ({m}).

dragon_starving.text: The hoard no longer fed you; hunger stood at {m}.

dragon_moulted.text: You moulted and woke in your {phase_word} phase, stiff from the long sleep.

sleep_begin.text: You settled into the lair to sleep {m0} years.

succession.text: {dead}, ruler of {O}, died; {S} took the throne.

reign_named.text: In {O}, {S} began a reign the chroniclers call {t0_word_the}.

offer_fulfilled.text: You did what {O} of {S} asked, and the court's faith deepened.

deceived_dragon.text: {O} of {S} had lied to you, and you acted on the lie.

arrival_envoy.text: An envoy of {S} climbed to your ledge.

arrival_pilgrim.text: Pilgrims of {S} came up to the mouth of your cave.

arrival_thief.text: A thief of {S} found the way into your lair.

arrival_slayer_band.text: A band of slayers of {S} reached your gate.

arrival_scholar.text: A scholar of {S} came to ask what you know.

arrival_kin.text: Kin of a captive held by you came from {S} to your ledge.
arrival_kin.brief: the kin who came from {s} in {year}

arrival_refugee.text: Refugees from {S} came up the slopes and begged for your shelter.

arrival_prophet.text: A prophet of {S} came to your ledge to see the dragon of the prophecy.

arrival_left.text: The visitors from {S} went home without being answered.

foothill_shrine.text: The pilgrims of {S} stopped at a shrine in the foothills and left their offerings there; none dared the climb.

arrival_answered.brief: your answer to the visitors of {s} in {year}

arrival_receive.text: You received the visitors of {S} on your ledge.
arrival_receive.brief: your welcome to the visitors of {s} in {year}

arrival_eat.text: You ate the visitors of {S} on your ledge.
arrival_eat.brief: your meal of the visitors of {s} in {year}

arrival_turn_away.text: You turned the visitors of {S} away from your ledge.
arrival_turn_away.brief: your refusal of the visitors of {s} in {year}

act_hunt.text: You hunted on {S} and ate well.

hook_pilgrims_turn_away.text: You turned the pilgrims of {s} away from the mouth of the cave.

person_died_old_age.text: {S}, {role} of {O}, died at the age of {p:age0}.

person_died_slain_by_dragon.brief: the death of {s} at your lair in {year}

person_died_warlord.text: {S}, warlord of {O}, fell to a rival, as warlords do.
person_died_warlord.brief: the fall of the warlord {s} in {year}

grudge.text: The dwarves of {S} wrote the name of {O} in the book of grudges.

grudge_dragon.text: The dwarves of {S} wrote your name in the book of grudges, and the book is long.
grudge_dragon.brief: the grudge {s} swore against you in {year}

grudge_war.text: The dwarves of {S} opened the book of grudges at the name of {O}.
grudge_war.brief: the grudge war {s} began on {o} in {year}

grudge_settled.text: The dwarves of {S} struck the name of {O} from the book: the debt was paid in land.

grudge_paid.text: The dwarves of {S} struck your name from the book of grudges; your gift had paid the debt.

oath_of_recovery.text: The elves of {S} swore to recover what {O} had taken from them, and the witnesses were afraid.
oath_of_recovery.brief: the oath of recovery {s} swore in {year}

oath_of_recovery_dragon.text: The elves of {S} swore to take back what you had carried off, and the witnesses were afraid.
oath_of_recovery_dragon.brief: the oath of recovery {s} swore in {year}

oath_of_recovery_war.text: The elves of {S} went to war on {O} to keep their oath.
oath_of_recovery_war.brief: the oath war {s} began on {o} in {year}

oath_hunts_the_dragon.text: The oath-bound wardens of {S} went looking for the way into your lair.

oath_released.text: The elves of {S} had back what was taken; with the oath fulfilled the old fire went out of them.

prophecy.text: The priests of {S} named the year the mountain would wake, and began counting.

prophecy_fulfilled.text: In {S} they said the prophecy was fulfilled.
prophecy_fulfilled.brief: the fulfilment of the prophecy in {s} in {year}

prophecy_fire.text: In {S} they said the prophecy was fulfilled: the fire had come back, as foretold.
prophecy_fire.brief: the prophecy of fire fulfilled in {s} in {year}

prophecy_grace.text: In {S} your coming without fire was read as the prophecy's grace, and the temples filled.
prophecy_grace.brief: the prophecy of grace fulfilled in {s} in {year}

dragon_blood.text: The kings of {S} claimed the mountain as grandfather, and some of them meant it.

dynasty_schism.text: The dragon-blood line of {S} split: one branch kept the mountain's name, the other swore to kill you.
dynasty_schism.brief: the schism of the dragon blood in {s} in {year}

hostage_came_home.text: {O} came home from your lair to {S}.

came_home_rules.text: {O} came home from your lair to {S} and took the throne; the court knelt to a dragon's ward.

came_home_rejected.text: {O} came home from your lair to {S}, and the court would not have a dragon's ward on the throne.

came_home_betrays.text: {O} came home from your lair to {S} and told the court where your lair is weakest.

treasure_hunters.text: Three sons of {S} went up the mountain with sacks.

treasure_hunters_failed.text: Three sons of {S}{,why,} went up the mountain with sacks. None came down.
treasure_hunters_failed.brief: the lost treasure hunters of {s} in {year}

treasure_hunters_robbed.text: Three sons of {S}{,why,} went up the mountain with sacks. One came down, and the sack was full.
treasure_hunters_robbed.brief: the theft from your hoard by {s} in {year}

dragon_forgotten.text: In {O} you were a story told to children, and the children did not believe it.
dragon_forgotten.brief: the long forgetting that began in {year}

dragon_remembered.text: The story came out of the mountain over {O}, and the valley remembered you.

pretender_returns.text: A claimant of the old kings of {T0} raised a host in {S} and marched on {O}.

pretender_hoard.text: A claimant of the old kings of {T0} raised a host in {S} and marched on {O}; the proof of the blood was the heir you hold.

restored_line.text: {O} was crowned in {S}, and the line of the old kings was restored.

dragon_temple_raised.text: {S} raised a temple to you, and carved on its walls what you did for them.
dragon_temple_raised.brief: the dragon temple of {s} raised in {year}

slayer_memorial.text: {S} set up a memorial to those you killed, so that no child of theirs would forget.

fire_memorial.text: {S} built a memorial from the stones of what you burned.

slayer_order.text: In {S} the slayers took vows and a name: an order, and orders outlive kingdoms.
slayer_order.brief: the founding of the slayer order in {s} in {year}

slayer_order_survives.text: The slayer order of {O} outlived its kingdom and kept its hall in {S}.

slayer_order_spreads.text: The slayers of {O} opened a chapter house in {S}.

slayer_martyrs.text: The order in {S} buried its dead in sight of your mountain and grew stronger for it.

false_dragon.text: {O} of {S} announced that the mountain spoke to the throne alone, and raised taxes in its name.
false_dragon.brief: the false voice of the mountain in {s} in {year}

false_dragon_judged.text: In {S} your strike was read as judgement on {O}, and the temples filled again.

false_dragon_dies.text: {O}, who had spoken in your name, died.

false_dragon_faith_returns.text: {O}, who had spoken in your name, died; in {S} they remembered that the real mountain had been seen.

false_dragon_disillusioned.text: {O}, who had spoken in your name, died; in {S} nobody believed in the mountain any more.

vein.text: The dwarves of {O} struck a vein under {s}, and every king in the valley remembered an old claim on the hills.

claim_on_the_hills.text: {S} remembered an old claim on the hills of {O}.

exodus.text: The people of {S} who lived in {o} would not live under {T0}; they left with what they could carry.

return_of_the_exiles.text: The {t0_race} who had left {s} came back, and they had not come to ask.
return_of_the_exiles.brief: the return of the exiles to {s} in {year}

sack_of_the_capital.text: The host of {O} sacked {t0_name}, the richest land of {S}, and carried off everything that could be lifted.

revenge_for_the_sack.brief: the war of revenge {s} began on {o} in {year}

old_enemies.text: {S} and {O} had fought so long that neither remembered the cause.
old_enemies.brief: the old feud of {s} and {o} from {year}

old_enemies_again.text: {S} and {O} went to war again, as they always had.
old_enemies_again.brief: the old feud of {s} and {o} renewed in {year}

dragon_raised_lineage_digested.text: In {S} a line began that claims your blood: the royals you carried off grew up as yours.

grudge_against_the_dragon.text: The dwarves of {S} read your name aloud from the book of grudges, and their engineers built another bolt-thrower.
grudge_against_the_dragon.brief: the reading of your name in {s} in {year}

act_burn_lands.text: You burned the lands of {s}; {m%} of its wealth went up in smoke.

hostage_taken_consent.text: {S}, {role} of {O}, came to your lair as a ward, with the court's consent.

hook_thief.text: You caught up with the thieves of {s} at {o} and took the gold back, and more.

hook_slayers.text: You met the slayers of {s} at the gate of the lair and broke the band.

hook_army.text: You fell on the host of {s} at {o} under the mountain.

hook_sack.text: You picked over the burning streets of {o} before {s} could.

hook_pilgrims_receive.text: You received the pilgrims of {s} at the mouth of the cave and took their offerings.

hook_pilgrims_eat.text: You ate the pilgrims of {s} at the mouth of the cave.

hook_dead.text: You drove the dead of {s} back at {o}; the living around them gave thanks.

hook_hero.text: You answered the challenge of {s}'s hero at {o} and killed him on his own walls.

hook_royal.text: You caught the court of {s} on the road from {o} and carried a royal to the lair.

hook_vein.text: You emptied the new halls of {s} under {o} of their artifacts.

hook_rival_god.text: You burned the pretender's temple of {s} at {o}; the offerings come to you again.

hook_war.text: You turned the war at {o} against {s}.

hook_fat_city.text: You took the fat of {s}'s new city at {o}.

hook_caravan.text: You emptied the treasury of {s} at {o}.

hook_ignored.brief: the call you let go in {year}

hook_herd.text: You fed on the herds of {s} at {o}.

hook_tyrant.text: You killed the tyrant of {s} at {o}; the court gave thanks.

hook_library.text: You carried off the library of {s} at {o}.

hook_horde.text: You fell on the camp of {s} at {o} and took its plunder.

prophecy_written.text: The scribes of {S} wrote down a prophecy of the dragon in the mountain, and kept the book in their library.

prophecy_spread.text: {S} learned the prophecy of the dragon from {O}.

prophecy_cult.text: In {S} a cult rose to make the prophecy come true, and began a shrine to you.

prophecy_slayers.text: {S} read the prophecy as a warning and armed against it.

prophecy_schism_order.text: The cult of {S} split over the prophecy: the Order holds that you are the prophecy, and holds the capital.

prophecy_schism_reformed.text: The cult of {S} split over the prophecy: the Reformed hold that you are its heresy, and hold the capital.

legend_worship.text: In {S} they kept the worship of an old dragon that had died before this valley's memory.

legend_fear.text: In {S} they still feared an old dragon that had died before this valley's memory.

legend_order.text: An order of {S} traced its founding to the death of an old dragon.
legend_order.brief: the order of the old dragon in {s}

legend_monument.text: In {S} stood a monument to an old dragon nobody had seen.

legend_gap.text: The library of {S} had a gap where an old dragon's story had been.

ending_ready.text: An ending came within your reach.

ending_lapsed.text: An ending slipped out of your reach.

ending.brief: the end of your reign in {year}

epilogue_over.text: The valley went on without you.

move_teach_reluctant.text: {S} took your teaching, though without love for it.

move_corrupt_reluctant.text: {S} agreed to serve your ends, after a long silence.

move_bargain_reluctant.text: {S} struck a bargain with you, and did not like its terms.

move_threaten_reluctant.text: {S} gave way to your threat, slowly.

move_court_reluctant.text: {S} was won by your courtship, and was afraid of it.

secret_exposed.text: {S} found out what you did to {o}.
secret_exposed.brief: the secret of {o} found out in {year}

inquisition.text: The devout of {S} rose against {o}, whom you had turned; the mages of {S} put their work aside.

purge_ultimatum.text: The purge in {S} demanded the fall of {o}.

purge_civil_war.text: {S} split over {o}: the purge would not give way, and neither would the court.

came_home_agent.text: {O} came home from your lair to {S} and kept your secrets there.

terms_sworn.text: {S} swore to the terms you sent home with {o}.

terms_refused.text: {S} refused the terms you sent home with {o}.

causes.ruler_gone: when the undying ruler was gone at last

causes.overlord_weak: because its overlord had grown weak after {ref}
causes.overlord_submitted: because its own overlord bent the knee

causes.usurped: because a bolder hand took the throne of a failing realm

causes.ruler_in_lair: because the ruler sat in your lair after {ref}
causes.royals_digested: as the lair's years worked on the hostage from {ref}
causes.human_wealth: with humans holding {p:share%} of the valley's wealth

causes.empty_ruin: because {ref} had left the land empty
causes.open_home: because its old home stood open since {ref}

causes.resentment: because an oath sworn in dread is kept in resentment
causes.era_outgrew: because {ref} made the old terms unbearable
causes.not_cowed: because the court was not cowed
causes.honest_offer: because {ref} asked honestly and you answered

causes.hoard_empty: because the hoard gave {p:food} against a need of {p:need}
causes.overlord_weak_noref: because its overlord had grown weak
causes.last_region_noref: because it had nothing left but its last land
causes.person_died_deposed.usurped: to a bolder hand while the realm was failing
causes.person_crowned.heir_in_lair: the heir being in your lair

reactions.memory.dwarf: the dwarves will carry it for five hundred years
reactions.memory.elf: the elves will never forget it
reactions.memory.orc: orcs forget within a lifetime, but not this season
reactions.burn.oath_active: {F} had your oath of {oath}. Its priests now call you the Oathbreaker; {memory}.
reactions.take.oath_active: {F} had your oath of {oath}, and you carried off its {loot} anyway. Its priests now call you the Oathbreaker; {memory}.
reactions.kill.oath_active: {F} had your oath of {oath}, and you killed its people anyway. Its priests now call you the Oathbreaker; {memory}.
reactions.burn.faithful: {F} worshipped you, and you answered with fire; its temples are emptying.
reactions.take.faithful: {F} worshipped you, and you carried off its {loot}; half its priests now preach against you.
reactions.kill.faithful: {F} worshipped you, and you killed its people; its temples are emptying.
reactions.burn.weak: {F} has nothing to answer fire with; it will pay what you ask and hate you quietly.
reactions.take.weak: {F} could only watch its {loot} go up the mountain.
reactions.kill_person.oath_active: {F} had your oath of {oath}, and you killed {person} anyway. Its priests now call you the Oathbreaker; {memory}.
reactions.kill_person.any: {F} will not forget what you did to {person}, and every court in the valley heard of it.
reactions.take_hostage.nobody: {F} hid its heirs from you this time.
reactions.release.nobody: {F} waited at the foot of the mountain for someone you no longer hold.
reactions.kill.weak: {F} buried its dead and bolted its doors.
reactions.harm.strong: {F} is strong enough to answer fire with iron: its smiths start on bolt-throwers.
reactions.harm.strong.dwarf: {F} is strong enough to answer fire with iron: its engineers start on a bolt-thrower.
reactions.harm.strong.elf: {F} is old and strong; its wardens string the long bows and learn your name.
reactions.harm.strong.orc: {F} howls for blood and sharpens spears long enough to reach you.
reactions.show_forgotten.any: {F} had stopped believing in you, and the sight of you came down on it like fire.
reactions.show_in_rage.any: {F} saw you overhead in a rage and took it for an attack.
reactions.defend.losing: {F} was losing its war, and you turned it; its people sing of the mountain now.
reactions.defend.not_losing: {F} was holding its own; it thanks you, warily.
reactions.show.any: {F} saw you overhead, and mothers kept their children in for a season.
reactions.show.awe: {F} saw you overhead and stopped work to watch; nobody ran.
reactions.defend.saved: {F} owes you its life, and its people carve your shape over their doors.
reactions.give.gift: {F} took your gift with both hands; its priests say you choose whom to keep.
reactions.give.any: {F} took your gift and wonders what you will ask for it.
reactions.give.any.dwarf: {F} weighed your gift twice and wrote it down.
reactions.miracle.protector: {F} saw the sky answer for it, and pilgrims start up the mountain road.
reactions.miracle.terror: {F} saw what you can do when you choose to; some of it kneels, all of it fears.
reactions.accept_offering.any: {F} saw its offering taken, and its priests grow bolder.
reactions.destroy_altar.any: {F} saw its altar broken; its priests curse your name and its faithful scatter.
reactions.take_hostage.any: {F} lost {person} to your lair; the court will pay, beg or plot.
reactions.release.any: {person} is home in {F}, and the court watches for signs of what your lair has made of its blood.
reactions.witness_burn.enemy: {F} watched you burn its enemy {T} and lit candles at your altar.
reactions.witness_burn.friend: {F} watched you burn its kin in {T} and barred its gates.
reactions.witness_burn.neutral: {F} saw the smoke over {T} and counted its own granaries.
reactions.offer.fulfilled: {F} had asked this of you through {envoy}; its faith in you deepens.
reactions.offer.deceived: {F} sent {envoy} to you with a lie, and you acted on it; the court has learned you can be used.
reactions.extra.offer_fulfilled: That was what {envoy} had asked of you, and the court's faith deepens.
reactions.extra.deceived: {envoy} had lied to you about why, and now the court knows you can be used.
reactions.extra.known.harm: {known}, whom you met in {met}, will not forget it.
reactions.extra.known.help: {known}, whom you met in {met}, counts you a friend now.
reactions.extra.known_new.harm: {known} has now seen you up close, and will not forget it.
reactions.extra.known_new.help: {known} has now met you, and will remember the help.
reactions.extra.known_new.seen: {known} has now seen you up close.
reactions.tag.dragon_forgotten: Nobody alive had seen you; they had taken you for a story until today.
reactions.tag.prophecy.harm: Its priests had foretold your return, and the fire fulfils the prophecy.
reactions.tag.prophecy.help: Its priests had foretold your return, and your mercy is read as the prophecy's grace.
reactions.tag.prophecy.seen: Its priests had foretold your return, and here you are.
reactions.tag.grudge.harm: Your name is already in its book of grudges; now there is a second line.
reactions.tag.grudge.help: Your name is in its book of grudges, and the book does not close for kindness alone.
reactions.tag.sworn.harm: It is sworn to take back what you carried off, and now it has another reason.
reactions.tag.sworn.help: It is sworn to take back what you carried off; a gift is not what it swore for.
reactions.tag.dragon_blood.harm: Its kings call you grandfather, and some of them will not forgive this.
reactions.tag.dragon_blood.help: Its kings call you grandfather, and today they have proof.
reactions.tag.slayer_order.harm: Its slayer order will take this as a summons.
reactions.tag.slayer_order.help: Its slayer order does not know what to make of you now.
reactions.tag.sacked.help: It has not forgotten its sack, and is grateful for any friend.
reactions.tag.robbed_the_dragon.harm: It knows why you came: someone there still has your gold.
reactions.tag.false_dragon: Its king claims to speak for you, and now has to explain you.
reactions.tag.old_enemies.help: Its old enemies will hear of it.
